annotation_method: Manual review of original video frames with ROI overlay at 0.4-second intervals. Two physical vehicles (first white car, red car) have bottom-center points inside the polygon long enough; second gray car and final white car stay to the left. Confirmation windows are coarse due to manually estimated bbox/entry timing.
use: Small admission/calibration video, not an independent accuracy benchmark. AI outputs were not used as ground-truth class labels.
